lucy (Finance): Contractors = swag only unless vendor invoice route. Cards processed as taxable benefits for employees. Include legal name + country for payroll.

recognition-bot: Reminder queued: nominations close in 3 days. :bell:

ana (People Ops): TL;DR nominate by Fri, managers confirm, finance needs final list next Tue. I'll export sheet and ping managers with checklist. Thanks! :raised_hands:
